# Quaternius 3D asset notice — QAL

The project uses these Quaternius packs as integrated game assets:

- RPG Characters
- LowPoly Animated Monsters
- Modular Dungeon

**License clarification:** These assets are not CC0 under the current Quaternius Asset License (QAL). The QAL permits use inside a completed game/product, but prohibits repackaging, selling, sublicensing, or otherwise redistributing the assets as a standalone asset pack.

License reference: https://quaternius.com/license.html
